T: It's clobbering time. Then dinner time.
D: Four astronauts gain strange powers after a cosmic storm and have to stop their former backer, Victor Von Doom.
P: Serve the snacks when the four save the day on the Brooklyn Bridge.
S: Baked chicken wings tossed in hot sauce and honey butter
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery glaze of hot sauce, honey and butter, with a cooling sour cream dip.
Cob loaf stuffed with garlic herb butter and melted cheese
A cob loaf sliced in a crosshatch, stuffed with mozzarella and garlic butter, baked at 180C for 20 minutes until the cheese stretches.
Invisible Woman clear lemon berry jelly

Crystal clear lemon and elderflower jelly set in shot glasses with fresh blueberries and raspberries hanging inside, almost invisible. Dissolve 4 tsp gelatine powder in 100ml hot water. Stir in 400ml lemonade that has gone flat, 2 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp elderflower cordial. Pour a little into 12 shot glasses and chill 30 minutes until just tacky. Add a few blueberries and raspberries from 250g, then top up with the rest of the jelly and chill 3 hours until set.
M: Short ribs rubbed with paprika, garlic and brown sugar, cooked five hours
Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika, garlic and brown sugar, cooked at 140C for 5 hours until a dark crust forms, with corn and slaw.
the team's home in the Baxter Building

Salmon fillets roasted on lemon slices with dill butter, with crushed garlic baby potatoes and charred asparagus. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and lightly crush with 30g butter, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt. Lay 2 sliced lemons in a roasting dish and set 4 salmon fillets on top. Mix 40g soft butter with 2 tbsp chopped dill and dot over the fish. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Grill 2 bunches asparagus with olive oil for 4 minutes. Serve together with the pan juices.
W: Vanilla ice cream under jammy blueberry sauce
Blueberries simmered with sugar into a sauce, spooned over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, topped with whipped cream and a sprinkle of popping candy.
K: Blueberries, banana, Greek yoghurt, milk and honey, blended thick

A thick, deep purple-blue smoothie of frozen blueberries, banana, Greek yoghurt and honey, topped with crunchy granola and fresh berries. Put 300g frozen blueberries, 2 bananas, 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk and 2 tbsp honey in a blender and blend for 1 minute until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 glasses. Top each with a spoon of granola and a few fresh blueberries, and serve straight away with wide straws.

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings through.
Serve with herbed sour cream and celery sticks to put the fire out.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss with the oil and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp and browned at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the cauliflower through.
Serve with the sour cream mixed with the herbs, and celery sticks to put the fire out.
Cut the loaf in a deep crosshatch without slicing through the base.
Mix the butter with garlic and parsley and push into the cuts with the mozzarella.
Wrap in foil and bake at 180C.
Unwrap and bake until golden.
Rub the ribs with paprika, garlic, sugar and salt.
Cook uncovered at 140C until a dark crust forms and the meat is tender.
Grill the corn, brush with butter, and toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for a slaw.
Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways and score the cut sides in a criss cross.
Rub the mushrooms with the oil, paprika, garlic, sugar and salt.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C, turning once, until a dark sticky crust forms.
Grill the corn, brush with butter, and toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for a slaw.

Cool the sauce.
Scoop ice cream into glasses, spoon over the sauce and top with whipped cream.

Pour into glasses and top with granola and fresh blueberries.

s.note: Baked chicken wings tossed in hot sauce and honey butter
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and 2 tbsp honey and toss the wings through. Serve with sour cream mixed with herbs and celery sticks to put the fire out.

s.note: Cob loaf stuffed with garlic herb butter and melted cheese
s.how: Cut a cob loaf in a deep crosshatch without slicing through the base. Mix 100g softened butter with crushed garlic and chopped parsley and push into the cuts with 250g grated mozzarella. Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 20 minutes, then unwrap for 5 minutes more.

m.note: Short ribs rubbed with paprika, garlic and brown sugar, cooked five hours
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with smoked paprika, garlic, brown sugar and salt. Cook uncovered at 140C for 5 hours until a dark crust forms and the meat is tender. Serve with buttered grilled corn and a crunchy cabbage slaw.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream under jammy blueberry sauce
w.how: Simmer 250g blueberries with 80g sugar and a splash of water for 8 minutes until jammy, then cool. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, spoon over the blueberry sauce and top with whipped cream. Scatter popping candy on top just before serving.

d.note: Blueberries, banana, Greek yoghurt, milk and honey, blended thick
d.how: Put 300g frozen blueberries, 2 bananas, 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk and 2 tbsp honey in a blender and blend for 1 minute until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 glasses. Top each with a spoon of granola and a few fresh blueberries, and serve straight away with wide straws.
